summary: Adds, replaces, appends, or removes CHOP channel attributes. Its current high-value use is tagging rotation channel triplets as quaternion data so compatible CHOPs can interpolate rotations with spherical interpolation.
key_concepts: Adds, removes, replaces, or appends CHOP channel attributes, with the current documented attribute type focused on quaternion rotation grouping.
Quaternion attributes group rotation triplets such as rx, ry, and rz so compatible CHOPs can use spherical linear interpolation instead of independent XYZ interpolation.
Join CHOP, Composite CHOP, Interpolate CHOP, Object CHOP, Stretch CHOP, and Resample CHOP are documented consumers of quaternion rotation attributes.
Function controls whether existing attributes pass through, are replaced, appended, or removed from the scoped channels.
Scope selects the channel triplets affected by the quaternion attribute; Rotate Order records the order used when interpreting the triplet.

key_params.name: slerp
key_params.note: Attribute operation: pass through, replace, append, or remove

key_params.name: rord
key_params.note: Rotation order used when grouping rotation triplets

key_params.name: scope
key_params.note: Channels that receive or lose the quaternion attribute

common_gotchas: The Scope must select the intended rotation triplet channels; unrelated channels should not be tagged as quaternion rotations.
Append errors if an attribute already exists on a scoped channel and would be overwritten.
Quaternion attributes improve rotation interpolation in compatible CHOPs, but they do not change the numeric channel samples by themselves.
